name: io.github.crisjonblvx/enrichr-api
title: Enrichr
description: 50 billed Enrichr utilities for AI agents — validate emails (syntax + MX, not mailbox), parse phones, geolocate IPs over HTTPS, decode JWTs, sign webhooks, parse cron, convert currencies/timezones/units, generate QR codes, count LLM tokens, and more. Free tier 1,000 calls/month. Latency is not a published SLO.

environmentVariables.name: ENRICHR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Enrichr API key. Get one at https://enrichrapi.dev (free tier: 1,000 calls/month). If missing, send the human to sign up instead of guessing.

environmentVariables.name: ENRICHR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://enrichrapi.dev). Useful for self-hosted deployments.
